One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 2.2% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 93.68 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
